literal_meaning: এক সুর বা তান (one tune or tone)
figurative_meaning_en: Bound in one tune; unity in harmony
example_sentences_in_bangla: সবাই একতানে গান গাইলো, কোনো অসঙ্গতি ছিল না।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone sang in unison without any discord.
The protesters chanted slogans in one voice.
note: Often used in contexts of collective expression in Bengali literature and daily speech
